design.whole_content_hypothesis: A complete explanation of the transition from apparent progress and public ignorance to discovery, compelled work and completion. It distinguishes a requirement to finish from finished cloth, knowledge that the second activity occurs from that activity itself, and an earlier epistemic condition from a later actual state. This is a proposed new commentary content, not a claimed additional Homer passage.
new_written_obligations: Four literal lchedy occurrences (.32,.34,.37,.41) keep KNOWLEDGE(OCCURS(SECOND(pair))). They never become the worker, an action, or a temporal phase.
Two shey occurrences (.36,.39) negate an epistemic condition under one reusable scope rule; no clause-specific switch to physical negation.
s at .33 retains THEN_AFTER preceding discovery; its domain must be resolved explicitly.
chedy at .42/.43 retains FINISHED of the same cloth; prospective or required mention does not execute completion.
saiin remains FIRST of the same ordered action-type pair, and sar remains the same public participants.
design.propagated_state: At the end of the preceding DIRECT whole reading the public participants have discovered U and the cloth has reached FINISHED through the compelled action Z. New assertion context after that endpoint inherits both unless a written constructor selects an earlier or intensional context. This no-unwritten-reset law is a NEW continuation assumption, not established paragraph syntax.
design.prospective_discriminator: Under an actual later-state continuation, a complete new assertion of NOT KNOWS(U) for the same public participants conflicts with retained discovery unless an explicit forgetting/loss-of-knowledge operation is written and paid. Under a marked retrospective commentary, the same old epistemic predicate can describe E without conflict. A complete draft must freeze every knowledge occurrence as assertion, quotation, requirement or retrospective report and derive at least one scope obligation from its unchanged written neighbors. It may not merely assign a free phase to each occurrence.
fixed_rivals: AFTER_COMPLETION: new unmarked finite assertions evaluate after Z.
RECAP_E: a single explicitly written initial discourse operator may scope a connected earlier-phase account; every escape from that scope must also be written.
A fresh cloth, worker or public participant class is not a free rival under these same lexical values; a distinct family would have to disclose changed denotations.
design.strongest_countercase: lchedy was itself a large fitted KNOWLEDGE/SECOND macro in RAW488. Its four new uses could all be quoted topics rather than asserted epistemic conditions; then the proposed inherited-state contrast might disappear. The complete62-group target also already supports an incompatible music hypothesis. No semantic victory is available from mere lexical coverage.
